productName: French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Hutch Top
description:
The French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Hutch Top has six drawers and a hutch top, giving you abundant storage and display space in one arrangement.

Six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide room for clothing, bedding, and essentials, while the hutch top offers open shelving for displaying books, stuffed animals, framed photos, and nursery decor. The lower dresser section stands independently, so you have the flexibility to use it with or without the hutch as your needs change.
